name: Diisostearyl malate
description: Diisostearyl malate (CAS 67763-18-2 ) is a diester of malic acid and isostearyl alcohol, supplied commercially under trade names including Pelemol DISM, Creaester IM, and Haimalate DIS. In personal care manufacturing, it functions as an emollient and plasticizer, delivering a smooth, non-greasy skin feel while improving the flexibility and payoff of cosmetic formulations. Lip color formulations including lipsticks, lip glosses, and liquid lips use this ingredient as a primary emollient base because it enhances pigment dispersion and contributes a comfortable, non-tacky texture. In color cosmetics such as eyeshadow sticks and pressed powders, it acts as a binder and softener, improving product cohesion and skin adhesion for better application and wear. Skincare formulators incorporate it into anhydrous balms and body butters where its moisturizing properties support long-wear hydration without the drawback of occlusive heaviness on the skin. It also functions as a plasticizer in mascara and eyeliner formulas, reducing brittleness and improving film flexibility on application to ensure a smooth and lasting finish for the user. The material is supplied as a viscous liquid or semi-solid depending on temperature. It is available in cosmetic-grade specification, the standard for personal care and color cosmetic applications. Packaging typically ranges from drums to IBCs for bulk procurement.
